def sandbox(argv, cwd, ro_dirs):
    """Allowlist root: /usr and /etc read-only, the given dirs read-only, the run dir cwd writable; the fake
    binaries also cover /usr/bin/<name>."""
    cmd = ["bwrap", "--ro-bind", "/usr", "/usr", "--ro-bind", "/etc", "/etc"] + root_links() + [
        "--dev", "/dev", "--proc", "/proc", "--tmpfs", "/tmp", "--unshare-pid", "--unshare-net", "--die-with-parent"]
    for d in ro_dirs:
        cmd += ["--ro-bind", d, d]
    for fb in FAKEBIN:
        for n in FAKE_NAMES:
            if os.path.exists("/usr/bin/" + n):
                cmd += ["--ro-bind", os.path.join(fb, n), "/usr/bin/" + n]
    cmd += ["--bind", cwd, cwd, "--chdir", cwd, "--"]
    return cmd + argv
